verdict.rationale: The Texas Workforce Commission is a state government agency whose online services (UTR/UTS tax registration, wage reporting) hold records the state is required to keep. Letting users choose a data-storage region or residency is a cloud/SaaS axis that does not fit a state agency's statutory recordkeeping. Nothing in the evidence suggests TWC offers such a choice, so this is a category mismatch rather than a missing feature.
